tracks.title: City In The Rearview

sources.title: Chill Beats (Collection) / Chill Beats/01 HoliznaCC0 - City In The Rearview.mp3
sources.author: Holizna

tracks.why: Warm, full lo-fi hip-hop mix (320 kbps source, clean master: no clipped runs, 12.7 dB crest) with a real intro and a natural fade ending; the title fits a driving game. [splice 50.4s->120.7s (section match 0.92, waveform corr 0.96)]

tracks.title: Chills
tracks.why: Noir chillhop with sax, wide stereo and a steady head-nod groove; adds a jazzier colour to the station and edits seamlessly (repeated 8-bar sections). [splice 79.7s->159.7s (section match 0.98, waveform corr 1.00)]

tracks.title: Keepin' the Pace
tracks.why: Guitar-led lo-fi from a well-rated Freesound producer (4.8/5); a different artist and timbre so the station does not feel single-source; clean master with no overs. [splice 48.3s->145.7s (section match 0.90, waveform corr 0.85)]

tracks.title: Windows Down

sources.title: Lo-Fi and Chill (Collection) / Lo-Fi And Chill (Lofi Collection)/02 HoliznaCC0 - Windows Down.mp3.mp3
sources.author: Holizna

tracks.why: Breezy, wide-stereo lo-fi (L/R corr 0.68, the widest on the station) with a warm sub and a moderately dynamic master (15.4 dB crest); the title suits cruising with the windows down. [splice 64.2s->142.7s (section match 0.97, waveform corr 1.00)]

tracks.title: Fires Uptown

sources.title: Retro Wave (Collection) / Retro Wave 1/05 HoliznaCC0 - Fires Uptown.mp3
sources.author: Holizna

tracks.why: Driving retrowave with bright arps, wide stereo and a dynamic master (17.6 dB crest); clear intro, break and natural ending. [splice 87.0s->175.2s (section match 0.95, waveform corr 0.98)]

tracks.title: Eyeless
tracks.why: Calm, moody night-drive synthwave from a lossless FLAC source; the darkest track on the station, which balances the two brighter Holizna cuts. [radio edit: first 97.0s, 6s fade ending on a section boundary]

tracks.title: All The Fight Left
tracks.why: Emotional, nostalgic synthwave with a clean, unclipped master (0 clipped runs, 17.6 dB crest) and a proper ending; the splice is near-perfect (loop sections repeat exactly). [splice 34.6s->110.6s (section match 0.99, waveform corr 1.00)]

tracks.title: Machines With Feelings

sources.title: Retro Wave (Collection) / Retro Wave 2/09 HoliznaCC0 - Machines With Feelings.mp3
sources.author: Holizna

tracks.why: Big, sub-heavy retrowave with a real arrangement (sparse intro, full sections, breakdown, outro; 10.8 LU range) and an essentially clean master (1 clipped run). [splice 49.7s->145.7s (section match 0.95, waveform corr 0.90)]

tracks.title: Wednesday Night
tracks.why: Composition-first funk fusion (chords, bass and melody) from a lossless WAV with a clean -0.6 dBFS master and wide stereo; upbeat but relaxed cruising energy. [splice 34.2s->109.6s (section match 0.90, waveform corr 0.60)]

tracks.title: Midnight Cruiser
tracks.why: Jazz-funk racing tune with busy funk bass (commenters single out the bass lines; used in a Steam game trailer); lossless source, clean -1.6 dBFS master. [radio edit: first 89.4s, 6s fade ending on a section boundary]

tracks.title: Raspberry Jam
tracks.why: New-jack-swing funk with a bright, punchy mix; one of the best-liked CC0 funk tracks on OpenGameArt (24 favourites, very positive comments). [radio edit: first 97.0s, 6s fade ending on a section boundary]

tracks.title: Daylight
tracks.why: Gently pulsing pads with a natural build and fade; complete track, no edit needed (4.7/5, 1.6k downloads).

tracks.title: Drops
tracks.why: Warm downtempo at 70 BPM with piano and a soft beat; one of the most downloaded CC0 ambient tracks on Freesound (4.8/5, 2.2k downloads). [radio edit: first 92.7s, 8s fade ending on a section boundary]

tracks.title: Cosmic Glow
tracks.why: Spacious piano-and-pad downtempo (4.7/5, 4.3k downloads); unclipped with a wide, stable stereo image. [radio edit: first 96.4s, 8s fade ending on a section boundary]

rejected.title: Foggy Headed (Holizna, Lo-Fi and Chill 3)
rejected.reason: Perfect SF title but a crushed master: -8.2 LUFS, 1.1 LU loudness range, 10.8 dB crest and 2,000+ runs of full-scale samples.

rejected.title: Snow Drift (Holizna, Lo-Fi and Chill)
rejected.reason: Clipped, over-limited master: -8.4 LUFS, 2,283 full-scale runs.

rejected.title: Make Funk (Holizna, Funk collection)
rejected.reason: Clipped master (-8.7 LUFS, 1,353 full-scale runs, 9.9 dB crest). The other tracks in the collection are clean but flat (1-4 LU range).

rejected.title: Mutant Club / Lost In The Jungle (Holizna, Retro Wave)
rejected.reason: Squashed masters (-7.9 / -9.4 LUFS, 9-10 dB crest, under 2 LU range).

rejected.title: Funky House (Of Far Different Nature)
rejected.reason: Only 69 s long, and -6.8 LUFS with an 8 dB crest (heavily clipped).

rejected.title: Pacific Ocean (josepharaoh99)
rejected.reason: LICENSING: the uploader says he did not make the music (credits Dan Alan), so the CC0 is not the author's. Excluded.

rejected.title: Cyberpunk Moonlight Sonata
rejected.reason: An arrangement of a very famous melody. The brief excludes obvious copies of famous songs.

rejected.title: Calm Relax 1 (Synthwave 421k) / Calm Ambient 2 (Synthwave 15k) / Another August (cynicmusic)
rejected.reason: The L/R correlation is about -0.1 (an anti-phase, super-wide image), so it collapses in mono. Synthwave 15k also has a 14.6 s silent tail.

rejected.title: Hypnotic Chill (Extended 4 minute mix) (cynicmusic)
rejected.reason: The MP3 source decodes to +1.8 dBFS (overs). It is busy DnB that fits neither the ambient nor the synth station.

rejected.title: Chill lofi inspired / lofi hip hop / Lofi again / Funky Hip Hop Lofi Jam (omfgdude)
rejected.reason: One-take arranger-keyboard recordings (Yamaha CVP/Motif/Triton styles), so they sound like auto-accompaniment. Very quiet (-19 to -23 LUFS); two are pure mono and one is under 90 s.

rejected.title: Since 2 A.M. / Iced Village / The Past (TAD)
rejected.reason: 8-bit lo-fi with chiptune square-wave leads.

rejected.title: Bossa Nova (Joth)
rejected.reason: 8-bit / chiptune instrumentation.

rejected.title: Kenney Music Jingles (all 85)
rejected.reason: All are mono game-UI jingles of 0.3-1.8 s. The only ones over 1.5 s (SAX07/NES00) play the descending 'fail' motif F-E-D#-D, and the rising motifs are all under 1 s, too short for a 1-4 s ident. Radio stingers from Freesound were used instead.

rejected.title: Cool Highway / Hot Roadway / Neon sign Circuit / Sunny City (MintoDog)
rejected.reason: Game-BGM racing loops of 80-120 s. Cool Highway and Hot Roadway are squashed (-8 LUFS, 9-10 dB crest), Neon sign Circuit is very bright and harsh (33% of energy in 2-6 kHz), and Sunny City is only 80 s.

rejected.title: Midnight Drive (congusbongus)
rejected.reason: A near-mono tracker mix (side channel -25 dB below mid).

rejected.title: 80s Mysterywave music (DesertDev)
rejected.reason: Phasey stereo (L/R correlation 0.17) and 74% of its energy sits below 60 Hz.

rejected.title: Detour / Barriers / Freeway Fumes / Empty Stretch (Zane Little Music)
rejected.reason: The same 'Road Trip Adventure' set as Midnight Cruiser, but narrower (L/R corr 0.97-0.98) with sequenced PS2/MIDI-style arrangements and no clean edit point. Two Zane Little tracks per station is enough.

rejected.title: Chill Lofi piano music (ZHRO, Freesound 688675)
rejected.reason: The description says the piano part was written by ChatGPT. Skipped out of caution about quality and provenance.

rejected.title: Wandering / Road In The Forest / Parallel Universe (Andrew kn)
rejected.reason: Good, but they build slowly over 4-7 minutes and have no repeated section to cut, so a 100 s edit would lose the build. Wandering's preview is also band-limited to 12 kHz.

rejected.title: ALTERNATE - Glad To Be Stuck Inside (Holizna)
rejected.reason: Strong lo-fi alternate (clean master, splice match 0.95); left out to stay inside the 20 MB budget (Windows Down was preferred for its driving title and wider stereo).

rejected.title: ALTERNATE - Lost in the Snow Wave (hatmix)
rejected.reason: Nice Vital-synth synthwave (rebalanced 'lower basslead' mix exists); its 47 s pad intro makes a ~96 s edit awkward; left out for budget.

rejected.title: ALTERNATE - Rhythm Garden (congusbongus)
rejected.reason: Good funky electronic alternate, but its 16.6 dB peak-to-loudness ratio means it would sit about 2 dB under the -16 LUFS target; left out for budget.
